Definition: from G575 and G1679; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.
BiblicalUsage: To hope for again, to expect back — Jesus telling his people to lend, hoping for nothing again, and love their enemies anyway. The word is about giving up the claim to be repaid.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the hardest kind of generosity: giving without keeping a ledger.
